Nvidia recently started trending on GitHub, and it has nothing to do with leadership changes. In this episode of The Download, discover why Nvidia's open-source Auto-Ontology repository surged by 8,000 stars in just a few days to become one of the most popular projects on GitHub. Learn how Auto-Ontology builds a semantic layer that maps business concepts to database tables, helping AI agents validate SQL queries and understand what your data actually means. 

Explore the repository and connect it to your agents via MCP, CLI, or APIs: https://github.com/NVIDIA/auto-ontology

description:
For the past six years, the GitHub Security Lab has worked to secure the open source ecosystem, surfacing practical principles that protect modern software supply chains. In this GitHub Universe 2026 session, Bas Alberts and Xavier René-Corail share what succeeded, what didn't, and why keeping security simple, engaging, and social makes vulnerability remediation stick across communities. Discover how tools like Dependabot, GitHub Secret Protection, and GitHub Code Security unite with AI agents to magnify collective security intelligence. Learn how the recent wave of AI is reshaping open-source security and how to safeguard your own repositories.

Speakers: 

Bas Alberts, Principal Security Researcher, GitHub 
Xavier René-Corail, Sr. Dir, Security Research, GitHub
